title: DFV Specialist Intervention Stream
description: An advanced training pathway for specialist DFV practitioners working with high‑risk, complex, and multi‑layered domestic and family violence cases. This stream focuses on lethality assessment, multi‑agency risk panels, advanced trauma practice, and system navigation for clients facing intersecting barriers.
outcomes: Conduct advanced lethality and dynamic risk assessments
Manage complex DFV cases involving multiple risk factors
Work effectively within multi‑agency risk panels
Support clients navigating intersecting systemic barriers
